desc: Analyze the problem constraints and requirements: N towns, M people with stamina constraints, Q range queries.
Identify that the problem can be modeled as a system of difference constraints ($P_v > P_{S_i}$) on a line graph.
Determine that a naive check per query is too slow and an offline approach is needed.
Select the "Sliding Window with Rollback Data Structure" approach: Iterate $R$ from 1 to $M$, maintain a valid window $[L, R]$ by rolling back $L$ when contradictions occur.
Design the data structure: A Segment Tree with Lazy Propagation to maintain the minimum required stamina $P_v$ for each town $v$.
Define operations: Range Max Update (to enforce $P_v \ge P_{S_i} + 1$) and Point Query (to check $P_{S_i}$).
Implement Rollback capability for the Segment Tree by storing a history of changes.

Implement the main loop: For each $R$, add constraints of person $R$. If contradiction (i.e., $P_{S_R} + 1 > \max_{v \in path} P_v$), rollback $L$ until consistent. Store the minimal valid $L$ for each $R$.
Answer queries by checking if $L_k \ge \text{minimal valid } L \text{ for } R_k$.
